contradictions.claimA: docs.rs latest for tauri-specta is 1.0.2 and documents the previous Tauri/Specta generation.
contradictions.claimB: The upstream main branch is Tauri Specta v2 and states that Tauri v2 requires Specta v2.
contradictions.resolution: Use the repository-pinned v2 release candidate and its generated output as the executable source of truth; do not copy v1 exporter examples into the skill reference.

contradictions.claimA: The desktop MockRuntime host proves registered IPC and runtime capability denial.
contradictions.claimB: Android and iOS execute Kotlin and Swift plugin implementations through platform bridges.
contradictions.resolution: Record desktop proof as implemented and retain separate planned Android/iOS runtime evidence. Native source presence and cross-compilation cannot certify a device invocation.

contradictions.claimA: Existing package copy calls graph_persist_snapshot SQLite persistence.
contradictions.claimB: GraphPluginState stores snapshots in an in-memory Rust map; durable SQLite is a separate core adapter responsibility.
contradictions.resolution: Describe plugin snapshot commands as an in-memory IPC mirror and point durable applications to createTauriSqlPersistenceAdapter. Do not claim restart durability for this plugin gate.

contradictions.claimA: A plugin default capability may be read as permission to call the full command surface.
contradictions.claimB: The package default contains only get-entity, get-list, and platform-ping; mutations, persistence, and clear require explicit permissions.
contradictions.resolution: Publish an exact permission table and keep the default explicitly read-only.
